Global (All).title: Global Outbreak of Omicron variant
Global (All).summary: Cases are spiking globally due to the new variant, causing widespread outbreaks.

Global (All).title: Cyber Attack Targeting Global Supply Chain
Global (All).summary: A new strain of malware has been detected in the global supply chain, threatening critical infrastructure.

Global (All).title: Rise in Global Civil Unrest Due to Economic Downturn
Global (All).summary: Protests are erupting globally as citizens respond to the economic downturn, leading to increased instability.

United States.title: House Committee Votes to Hold Mark Zuckerberg in Contempt Over Meta Data Requests
United States.summary: A House committee voted to hold Mark Zuckerberg in contempt of Congress over Meta’s refusal to comply with a subpoena related to the company’s data collection practices.

United States.title: US Charges Chinese National in Massive Hacking Scheme
United States.summary: The US Department of Justice has charged a Chinese national with being part of a massive hacking scheme that targeted over 100 companies and government agencies worldwide.

United States.title: White House Says FBI Director Wray Will Testify on Domestic Terrorism
United States.summary: The White House has announced that FBI Director Christopher Wray will testify on Capitol Hill about domestic terrorism, amid growing concerns about the threat of extremism in the US.

South Korea.title: North Korean Ballistic Missile Test Fails Mid-Flight
South Korea.summary: North Korea's latest ballistic missile test ended in failure, with the rocket exploding mid-air, increasing tensions on the Korean Peninsula.

South Korea.title: Samsung Leader Lee Jae-Yong Sentenced to 5.5 Years in Prison
South Korea.summary: Samsung heir Lee Jae-yong has been sentenced to 5.5 years in prison for his role in a 2017 corruption scandal involving South Korean President Park Geun-hye, sparking fears of economic instability.

South Korea.title: South Korea's Yoon Suk-yeol Warns of 'Grave and Critical' Security Threat from North Korea
South Korea.summary: South Korean President Yoon Suk-yeol has expressed his concerns over North Korea's military advancements, describing the security threat as 'grave and critical', amidst growing tensions between the two nations.

Japan.title: Japan Extradites Ex-Military Officer to Japan Over Alleged Spies
Japan.summary: Japan has extradited a former US military intelligence officer to Japan, where they will face charges related to alleged espionage. The US has requested the extradition, but the details of the allegations have not been disclosed.
